CustomField.description: BACKEND-ONLY. Comma-separated list of additional guest email addresses captured at booking time via the Add Guests UI on the public scheduler. Read by ZoomMeetingManager (via the SA's Lead__r relationship) so guests are CC'd on the schedule / reschedule / cancel emails and listed as ICS ATTENDEE entries on the calendar invite. Populated by GuestSchedulerController.bookIC at lead-creation time.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Backend-only. Populated automatically by the booking widget; do not edit manually.
CustomField.label: Guest Emails
